R1 changes ONLY the projection input (⟨h(c_x),r_B⟩ vs PV ⟨c_last,r_B⟩); R2 changes ONLY the projection input (pooled generation acts). r_B extraction, eval rig, judge, metric, corpus all held constant (corpus LMSYS→WildChat→UltraChat fallback correctly flagged in §-assumptions). ### Item 4 — Direct-predictor arm capacity match: PASS

Match is strict.

### Item 5 — Post-fact-check patch (40→13) consistency: FINDINGS (drives the WARN)
The 40→13 fix was correctly applied to every location that DEFINES the experimental design (condition count §0/§4.3/§6/§10; pass-A rollout count 15.6k in the §9 table line 324; within-mode averaging over 8/5 conditions in §6/§7).
